description: This file defines a PHP class 'Ddos' within the Opencart admin extension, responsible for managing DDoS fraud detection features such as displaying status, saving configurations, installing/uninstalling, and reporting IPs involved in DDoS attacks.

classes.name: Ddos
classes.description: Controller class for managing DDoS fraud detection features within the Opencart admin extension

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the DDoS fraud detection configuration page with breadcrumb navigation and current status

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving configuration settings for the DDoS fraud detection feature

methods.name: install
methods.description: Installs the DDoS fraud detection extension if user has permission

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Uninstalls the DDoS fraud detection extension if user has permission

methods.name: report
methods.description: Displays IP addresses involved in DDoS attacks along with related customer data
